title: smithable.auth.yml
description: Who signs in, the roles, the default access, and what is public.

signIn.description: "none" for an app without sign-in (only "public" is reachable then), or how people sign in.

providers.description: The sign-in methods, in button order: email, google, facebook.

allowedDomains.description: Only addresses on these domains may sign up, e.g. [acme.example].

selfSignUp.description: Whether anyone with an account at a provider may sign up (true by default); false lets only invited addresses and the admins sign in.

defaultAccess.description: The default access to records: shared (colleagues see each other's) or private (each sees their own).

roles.description: The roles, by name (camelCase): all (the whole app; always admin's), or a block with a description and what the role may do beyond the record rule. admin always exists, and so does a role for everyone else: member, when none is named.

description.description: What the role is for, in a sentence.

pages.description: Pages the role may open; all is every page but the administrators'.

read.description: Models whose every record the role reads (with private access).

create.description: Models the role may add records of.

write.description: Models whose every record the role may change.

delete.description: Models whose every record the role may delete.

actions.description: Custom actions the role may run (a standard action follows write).

review.description: Models whose waiting pictures and files the role approves or rejects; opens the review page for them.

defaultRole.description: The role new users get; never admin.

admins.description: Email addresses that get the admin role when they sign in, also one added later, and may always sign in.

public.description: What anyone may open, read or create without signing in.

pages.description: Pages anyone may open (the sign-in page always is).

oneOf.description: A model with only the records that have these values: { Post: { where: { status: published } } }.

where.description: A choice field's value or a list of them, or a yes/no field's true or false.

read.description: Models anyone may read, or only the records of them with certain values.

create.description: Models anyone may create a record of, e.g. a contact form's.

api.description: What other programs may reach with a key, under /api/v1. A key is made in the app by an administrator, with a role, and that role's access decides what it may do.

models.description: all (also models added later), or the models other programs may reach.

except.description: With all: the models left out.

actions.description: Standard actions of the offered models they may run: all, or a list.

assistants.description: true offers the same to AI assistants as tools (/mcp); { delete: true } lets them delete too.

assistant.description: "Ask", the assistant in the app, for the people who use it. It acts as the person asking.

for.description: Who gets it: the roles ([admin, staff]), or signed-in (everyone who signs in), or anyone (visitors too, answered by the app's wording rules over what is public, never by a model).

may.description: read (the default): it finds, counts and adds up; change: it also adds, changes and runs standard actions, each confirmed by the person. It never deletes.
